export_contract.purpose: Define the stable downstream-readable product export layer without tying app/product directly to historical research artifacts.
forbidden_sources: historical compare artifacts as direct product truth
historical summary artifacts as direct product truth
raw research outputs as app-facing exports
paper-only artifacts as machine-readable truth carriers
export_contract.reading_rule: Product/app layers should read canonical contracts first and use historical research artifacts only through explicit canonical mapping.

notes: Toto zatial nie je finalny app export subor s metrikami.
Je to machine-readable export contract pre buducu product/export vrstvu.
Ciel je zamedzit priamemu napojeniu downstream vrstiev na historical chaos.
